applies_why: The judge labels Matthew 1:20 UNDERDETERMINED because two parties give two readings of the conception agency, which is what K-S2 addresses.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: "A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand": read as barring UNDERDETERMINED where two senses are pressed, versus read as allowing underdetermination when sides disagree about a single verse.
why: The judge makes the single verse's competing senses the reason for UNDERDETERMINED, rather than treating both senses as standing under K-S2.
